text:
zoe_pr: Quick sync : TechCrunch ran a short summary of our benchmark and included an inaccurate quote from a partner call: it says "50% cost savings typical". Our public claim is "up to 50% on select workloads; average ~30%". Need a tidy correction and partner comms.

alejandro_marketing: Thanks : I'll pause syndication and hold socials until PR says go.

sophie_engineering: Confirmed the public doc shows average ~30% and peak 50%. Suggest wording: "Correction: average ~30%; peak up to 50% on select workloads."

zoe_pr: Draft to reporter: "Hi : quick clarification for your TechCrunch summary: our public benchmark language is 'average ~30% cost reduction; peak savings up to 50% on select workloads.' Could you update the line to match our wording? Happy to supply the methodology appendix. Best, Zoe (PR)."

press_bot: reporter_email_delivered: true

zoe_pr: Reporter replied: "Thanks : we'll update the blurb and append an editor's note." They asked for the one-line we want. Pasted above.

ryan_sales: Heads-up: had 3 prospects forward the TechCrunch link with the 50% line. Can we send a short note for reps to forward with corrected stat?

alejandro_marketing: Draft sales note: "Correction: Our benchmark shows an average ~30% cost reduction; peak savings up to 50% on certain workloads. See methodology at [link]." I'll post in #sales.

ops_bot: audit_flag: attachments shared with reporter must be scrubbed.

sophie_engineering: Uploaded a redacted CSV to secure share and confirmed no customer IDs. Zoe, used that file?

zoe_pr: Confirmed. Sent redacted appendix. Reporter confirmed update.

press_bot: article_update_detected: https://techcrunch.com/example-updated

alejandro_marketing: TechCrunch updated. Social hold released; scheduled posts live. Sales note posted to #sales and pinned.

ryan_sales: Forwarding correction to prospects now. Thanks for the fast response.

zoe_pr: Closing: saved email thread and assets to comms drive. If we see further syndication with the old phrasing, tag me and we'll follow up. :white_check_mark:
